productionResult.source:
# EX06: POM filter/analyzer + isotropic dielectric, and measured angular sweep.
# Change incidence/filter/analyzer then Run. Both views have real navigation.
# No birefringent specimen/full microscope, inter-ray interference or laser phase.
optics: .physics.optics
:.math
s_power(angle: num, index: num) -> num:
    state: optics.reflected_stokes(optics.linear(1, 0), 1, index, cos(angle))
    optics.detector(state)
p_power(angle: num, index: num) -> num:
    state: optics.reflected_stokes(optics.linear(1, pi / 2), 1, index, cos(angle))
    optics.detector(state)

point2(x: num, y: num) -> [num: 2]: [x, y]
point3(x: num, y: num, z: num) -> [num: 3]: [x, y, z]
filter_power(angle: num, index: num, incidence: num, source_angle: num) -> num:
    filtered: optics.polarizer(optics.unpolarized(1), source_angle)
    sample: optics.transmitted_stokes(filtered, 1, index, cos(incidence))
    analyzed: optics.polarizer(sample, angle)
    optics.detector(analyzed)

view: .ui.viewport
index: 1.5
incidence: atan(index)
polarizer_angle: pi / 2
analyzer_angle: pi / 2
initial: optics.unpolarized(1)
filtered: optics.polarizer(initial, polarizer_angle)
reflected: optics.reflected_stokes(filtered, 1, index, cos(incidence))
transmitted: optics.transmitted_stokes(filtered, 1, index, cos(incidence))
detected: optics.polarizer(reflected, analyzer_angle)
h: [0, 0, 0.8]
source: [-2 * sin(incidence), 2 * cos(incidence), 0.8]
incoming: [point3(source.0, source.1, source.2), point3(h.0, h.1, h.2)]
outgoing: [point3(h.0, h.1, h.2), point3(2 * sin(incidence), 2 * cos(incidence), 0.8)]
refracted: optics.refract2([sin(incidence), -cos(incidence)], [0, 1], 1, index)
through: [point3(h.0, h.1, h.2), point3(2 * refracted.direction.0, 2 * refracted.direction.1, 0.8)]
floor: [[-3, -2, 0], [3, -2, 0], [3, 2, 0], [-3, 2, 0]]
interface: [[-1, 0, 0.4], [1, 0, 0.4], [1, 0, 1.2], [-1, 0, 1.2]]
# Filter/analyzer planes cross actual incoming/reflected rays at midpoint.
fx: source.0 / 2
fy: source.1 / 2
ax: sin(incidence)
ay: cos(incidence)
polarizer_mesh: [point3(fx, fy - 0.3, 0.4), point3(fx, fy + 0.3, 0.4), point3(fx, fy + 0.3, 1.2), point3(fx, fy - 0.3, 1.2)]
analyzer: [point3(ax, ay - 0.3, 0.4), point3(ax, ay + 0.3, 0.4), point3(ax, ay + 0.3, 1.2), point3(ax, ay - 0.3, 1.2)]
detector_face: [point3(2 * ax, 2*ay - 0.2, 0.5), point3(2 * ax, 2*ay + 0.2, 0.5), point3(2 * ax, 2*ay + 0.2, 1.1), point3(2 * ax, 2*ay - 0.2, 1.1)]
faces: [[0, 1, 2], [0, 2, 3]]
view.set_geom_options(background: [0.025, 0.035, 0.06, 1], render_options: (show_light_markers: true, light_flares: true, light_marker_size: 0.12))
view.add(p: floor_up, faces: faces_uv, id: "bench", color: [0.18, 0.22, 0.29, 1], roughness: 0.7)
view.add(p: interface_up, faces: faces_uv, id: "dielectric", color: [0.25, 0.62, 0.9, 1], optical_index: index, reflectivity: reflected.0 / filtered.0, transparency: transmitted.0 / filtered.0, roughness: 0)
view.add(p: polarizer_mesh_up, faces: faces_uv, id: "polarizer-shadow-caster", color: [0.35, 0.38, 0.5, 1], roughness: 0.4, casts_shadow: true)
view.add(p: analyzer_up, faces: faces_uv, id: "analyzer", color: [0.25, 0.3, 0.45, 1], roughness: 0.3, casts_shadow: true)
view.add(p: detector_face_up, faces: faces_uv, id: "detector", color: [0.2, 0.7, 0.35, 1], emissivity: detected.0, roughness: 0.5)
view.add(p: incoming_uc, id: "filtered-ray", color: [1, 0.7, 0.12, filtered.0], w: 3)
view.add(p: outgoing_uc, id: "reflected-ray", color: [1, 0.5, 0.12, reflected.0], w: 3)
view.add(p: through_uc, id: "transmitted-ray", color: [0.3, 0.75, 1, transmitted.0], w: 3)
view.add_light(id: "source-with-flare", pos: source, color: [1, 0.85, 0.55, 1], intensity: 6, source_radius: 0.12, spread: 1, range: 10, casts_shadow: true, show_marker: true)
view.add_camera(pos: [4, -5, 3], target: [0, 0, 0.6], up: [0, 0, 1], fov: 42)
view.push()
view.show()
plot: .ui.viewport
angles: [0..180] * pi / 360
degrees: [0..180] / 2
rs: s_power(angles_u, index)
rp: p_power(angles_u, index)
malus: filter_power(angles_u, index, incidence, polarizer_angle)
plot.add(x: degrees_u, y: rs_u, id: "s-polarized-reflection", color: [0.2, 0.65, 1, 1], w: 2)
plot.add(x: degrees_u, y: rp_u, id: "p-polarized-reflection", color: [1, 0.45, 0.12, 1], w: 2)
plot.add(x: degrees_u, y: malus_u, id: "transmitted-filter-analyzer-detector", color: [0.3, 0.8, 0.25, 1], w: 2)
plot.push(x_label: "Incidence / analyzer angle (degrees)", y_label: "Fresnel reflected power fraction", y_min: 0, y_max: 1)
plot.show()
:: optics.detector(detected)
:: optics.detector(transmitted)
